fields.mechanism: Friction-induced velocity-weakening instability in rolling contact, where increased static friction coefficient at low temperatures causes a drop in available torque below the threshold required to maintain rotational equilibrium.
fields.intervention: Implement a thermal management loop using a Joule-heated bearing housing to maintain the grease fluidity coefficient above the critical shear-thinning threshold during shadow periods, preventing the transition from fluid lubrication to boundary lubrication.
fields.expected_effect: Continuous torque generation at low temperatures, eliminating intermittent stall and attitude drift by maintaining the reaction wheel in a stable fluid-lubrication regime.
fields.falsification_test: Conduct a single on-orbit test by cycling a specific reaction wheel's housing heater from OFF to ON during the next eclipse (shadow) period while logging motor torque telemetry; a successful test is confirmed if the torque ripple amplitude drops below the stall threshold and attitude drift ceases while the wheel remains in shadow.

candidate.mechanism: Friction-induced velocity-weakening instability in rolling contact, where increased static friction coefficient at low temperatures causes a drop in available torque below the threshold required to maintain rotational equilibrium.
candidate.intervention: Implement a thermal management loop using a Joule-heated bearing housing to maintain the grease fluidity coefficient above the critical shear-thinning threshold during shadow periods, preventing the transition from fluid lubrication to boundary lubrication.
candidate.expected_effect: Continuous torque generation at low temperatures, eliminating intermittent stall and attitude drift by maintaining the reaction wheel in a stable fluid-lubrication regime.
candidate.falsification_test: Conduct a single on-orbit test by cycling a specific reaction wheel's housing heater from OFF to ON during the next eclipse (shadow) period while logging motor torque telemetry; a successful test is confirmed if the torque ripple amplitude drops below the stall threshold and attitude drift ceases while the wheel remains in shadow.

fields.mechanism: Spherical reaction wheel geometry eliminating fixed-axis bearing preload variation
fields.intervention: Replace the conventional cylindrical rotor and paired angular-contact bearings with a spherical rotor supported by a symmetric multi-point bearing arrangement to decouple differential thermal contraction from bearing preload.
fields.expected_effect: Uniform radial clearance across all support points at low temperature prevents asymmetric friction torque spikes, eliminating intermittent stall during eclipse-induced thermal transients and halting attitude drift.
fields.falsification_test: Command a constant low-speed rotation through an entire orbital eclipse transition while logging motor current; if peak-to-peak current ripple exceeds the sunlit baseline by more than 10%, the mechanism is falsified.
